home.title: Comic stories made for the screen
home.lead: Storink publishes comics you read panel by panel, on a phone or a large screen. Each series is written by an author and drawn with the help of artificial intelligence. Reading is free: no account, no cookies.
home.demoCaption: {series}, {episode}. Reading follows the panels, one by one.
home.demoAlt: A page of {series}, read panel by panel

how.title: One panel at a time
how.text: Tap the right side of the screen for the next panel, the left side to go back. One button shows the whole page; pinch to zoom in on a detail.

how.title: An author, helped by AI
how.text: The author writes the story, the breakdown and the dialogue, and checks the facts. Images are generated page by page, then corrected. Every series says so.

how.title: Free to read
how.text: No sign-up, no cookies, no IP address stored. A story comes in French, English or both, depending on what the author has translated.

next.title: More authors
next.text: Storink will open its pages to other comic creators. The authors' space is being designed.
